name:        Grid
domain:      component
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Grid
description: A CSS grid layout container for arranging children in rows and columns. Use Grid for card galleries, dashboards, and any multi-column layout. For columns that reflow on small screens, use `columns={{minWidth, max}}`; a numeric `columns` is exactly N columns at every width and never reflows.

name:        useCalendarDays
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/Calendar
description: Builds the day grid for one month: every date to show, including the previous and next months' days that fill the first and last weeks, grouped into weeks, plus localized weekday header names that start on weekStartsOn. It is the layout Calendar uses, for a custom month view such as a compact availability grid or a mini calendar. It returns data only: rendering, selection, keyboard navigation and the grid's accessibility semantics are the caller's.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useCalendarDays

name:        useGridFocus
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/hooks
description: Manages keyboard navigation within a 2D grid following the WAI-ARIA grid pattern. Supports arrow keys for cell-to-cell navigation, Home/End for row boundaries, Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End for grid boundaries, and Page Up/Down for custom callbacks (e.g., month navigation in calendars). Boundary navigation callbacks allow cross-grid navigation.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useGridFocus

name:        useMultiCombobox
domain:      hook
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/MultiSelector
description: Tracks the active option of a multi-select combobox and handles its keys, while DOM focus stays on the control. It powers MultiSelector; unlike useCombobox, toggling an option keeps the list open, and rows can carry an action cell. It renders nothing and sets no attributes: the caller renders the control and the list, and wires the ARIA attributes from what it returns.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 hook useMultiCombobox
